extraction.name: MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark
extraction.description: MVBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the temporal understanding capabilities of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). It covers 20 challenging video tasks that require temporal reasoning, generated by converting static image tasks into dynamic video tasks. The dataset includes multiple-choice question-answer pairs automatically generated from 11 public video benchmarks using LLMs.
extraction.creator: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao
extraction.publisher: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Shanghai AI Laboratory; The University of Hong Kong; Fudan University; State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University
extraction.citeAs: Li et al., MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark, arXiv:2311.17005, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The data was collected by selecting videos from 11 existing public video benchmarks. Videos were filtered based on diversity, temporal sensitivity (duration between 5s and 35s), and question difficulty. Multiple-choice QA pairs were then automatically generated using ChatGPT based on task definitions and ground-truth annotations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Videos and annotations from 11 public video benchmarks: STAR, PAXION, Moments in Time V1, FunQA, CLEVRER, Perception Test, Charades-STA, MoVQA, NTU RGB+D, VLN-CE, and TVQA.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Videos were filtered to ensure intermediate duration (5s-35s) and diversity. Questions were generated or adapted to multiple-choice format. Answer options were shuffled and length-normalized using LLMs to prevent bias.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos were selected from public datasets based on temporal sensitivity and diversity criteria. Annotations were converted into multiple-choice QA format. Answer options were processed to ensure similar lengths and random shuffling.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Multiple-choice QA pairs were automatically generated using ChatGPT. For some tasks, questions were directly adopted from existing annotations. For others, ChatGPT generated questions based on task definitions. Answer options were constructed from ground truth, antonyms, or LLM-generated candidates.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark aims to evaluate and improve the temporal understanding capabilities of MLLMs, which are critical for real-world applications. It highlights the limitations of current models in temporal perception and cognition.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset covers various domains and scenes, ranging from first-person to third-person perspectives and indoor to outdoor environments, aiming for diversity. However, it relies on existing public benchmarks which may have their own inherent biases.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current MLLMs perform poorly on position, count, and character tasks, often performing similarly to random guessing. The dataset may have source gaps between instruction tuning data and evaluation tasks (e.g., CLEVRER and SthSthV2).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning of Multi-modal Large Language Models for video understanding and temporal reasoning.
